scenes.title: The weightless feeling
scenes.purpose: Hook: a tap feels weightless, but the cloud is a place with walls, power and an address.
scenes.visual: A phone with app tiles answers a tap instantly; the camera goes through the screen onto an inked map of India where three chips (walls, power, an address) land and a building pin drops on Delhi.

transition_out.continuity: Camera pushes into the Delhi pin; the building closeup takes over.

layout.portrait: Phone/map in the upper two thirds (y 140-800); kicker and headline at y 822-890; captions y 906-1016.

beats.action: phone and app tiles pop in
tap ring on the first tile, answer bars race
tiles and cloud drift: nothing seems to be there
headline swaps to 'The cloud is a place.'; camera goes through the screen
India outline inks on
chips Walls, Power, An address land one by one
building pin drops on Delhi

scenes.narration: You tap an app, and it answers instantly. It feels like nothing is there. But the cloud is a place, with walls, with power, and with an address.

scenes.title: A fire in someone else's building
scenes.purpose: State the event: June 2026, Delhi, a third-party data center, an emergency power shutdown of a network junction. Cause not disclosed.
scenes.visual: Elevation drawing of a data center inks on; flames and smoke at one window; a lens magnifies the Point of Presence rack; its LEDs go out when the power-off badge lands.

transition_out.continuity: Camera pulls back from the building to the full map.

on_screen_text: A fire at a third-party site.

layout.portrait: Building elevation left and centre, PoP lens right; stamps stacked left above the headline.

beats.action: building draws on
fire starts at the window
'Non-compute PoP' stamp
lens opens on the PoP rack
power-off badge; LEDs die one by one; shutdown stamp
'Cause: not disclosed' stamp

scenes.narration: In June twenty twenty-six, a fire broke out at a third-party data center in Dell-ee. Google's servers were not the problem. But a network junction there, called a point of presence, was forced offline by an emergency power shutdown. Google has not said what started the fire.

scenes.title: One junction, three cities
scenes.purpose: A PoP is where traffic enters the network; isolating it slows traffic from Delhi, Chennai and Mumbai, with possible packet loss.
scenes.visual: Map with three roads between the cities and streaming dots; Delhi goes dark, vermilion ripples travel outward and each city lights marigold when felt; a few dots fall off the road.

layout.portrait: Full map upper stage; stamp in the Bay of Bengal area right.

beats.action: traffic streams on the three roads
Delhi node blacks out; ripples start
Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai ring marigold in turn
latency squiggles; packets fall off the roads
'Packet loss possible' stamp

scenes.narration: That junction is where traffic enters Google's network. When it went dark, people in Dell-ee, Chen-eye, and Mumbai felt it. Connections slowed down, and some data may have been lost along the way.

scenes.title: The detour has less room
scenes.purpose: Rerouting worked, but the alternate paths were narrower: demand exceeded capacity; Google said there was no workaround.
scenes.visual: Two thin bypass roads draw around the dark Delhi node with crowded traffic; dots queue at Mumbai and Chennai; a demand bar overflows the capacity mark.

layout.portrait: Map left and centre; capacity and demand bars right.

beats.action: bypass roads draw on
traffic streams along the thin roads
capacity and demand bars; queue dots pile at Mumbai and Chennai
'No workaround' stamp

scenes.narration: Google rerouted the traffic. But the detours were narrower than the road they replaced. Demand was bigger than capacity, so traffic queued up. And for a while, Google said, there was no workaround.

scenes.title: Weeks to rebuild
scenes.purpose: Recovery took weeks: capacity added route by route; crews reached the site on 22 June; service normal on 26 June.
scenes.visual: A dated vertical timeline (9 to 26 June, proportional) while emerald roads redraw over the dark ones and nodes relight; a hard hat marks the crews.

layout.portrait: Map left and centre; timeline in the right-hand panel from y 574 to 738.

beats.action: timeline starts at 9 Jun
emerald Delhi roads redraw
Chennai capacity and ring road
hard hat over the Delhi pin
26 Jun: all routes flow again

scenes.narration: Recovery took weeks. Google added capacity, route by route, in Dell-ee, and then in Chen-eye. Crews reached the damaged site on June twenty-second. By June twenty-sixth, service was back to normal.

scenes.title: The cloud has an address
scenes.purpose: Takeaway: a backup only works if it has room; the cloud is buildings, power and cables, each with an address.
scenes.visual: The phone returns with its first tile stuck on a spinner; the cloud falls and lands with weight; icons for buildings, power and cables; the closing line holds with a source note.
on_screen_text: Source: Google Cloud Service Health, Delhi incident, June 2026

layout.portrait: Cloud on a ground line y 470, icons y 506-604, closing line y 640; source note y 944.

beats.action: phone returns, spinner on first tile
cloud lands with weight
buildings, power, cables
closing line; holds to the end

scenes.narration: A backup only works if it has room. The cloud is not weightless. It is buildings, power, and cables. And every one of them has an address.
